t: The Bull Case For Illumina (ILMN) Could Change Following Buybacks And NovaSeq X Roadmap Reveal – Learn Why - Simply Wall St News
s: 18 hours ago - To be an Illumina shareholder today, you really have to believe in sustained demand for high throughput sequencing and Illumina’s ability to keep its platforms central to that workflow. The completed US$1.02 billion buyback and the NovaSeq X enhancement roadmap may support confidence in the current product cycle, but they do not remove the key near term risk around end market softness and competitive pressure in high and mid throughput sequencing.
